Bookmark Manager

Save bookmarks with title, URL and tags; search, filter, and export them as JSON.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste the URL and give it a title.
  2. Add comma-separated tags (optional) for easy filtering.
  3. Click Save Bookmark — click a saved row's × to delete it.
  4. Use search or the tag filter to find things, or Export JSON for a backup.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I add a bookmark?

Type or paste the full address (https://…), give it a title, optionally add comma-separated tags, and click Save Bookmark.

How do search and filters work?

The search box matches the title, URL and tags together. The tag filter dropdown shows only bookmarks with that tag.

Can I export my bookmarks?

Click Export JSON to download a file with all your bookmarks, which you can back up or import elsewhere.

Where are bookmarks stored?

Bookmarks live in this browser's localStorage only — private to this device, and they disappear if browser data is cleared.
